actual_request.prompt:

Image1 is edit target and exact west/left-facing proportion reference. Image2 is original character identity ONLY. Image3 is confirmed MAIN STYLE: clean bright rounded hand-painted Daoist chibi, no interface copied.
Change ONLY the actual legs and tiny natural cloth response to this gait phase: Preserve exactly the target's thigh connections, near-over-far overlap and foot placement. Keep RIGHTMOST trailing boot toe planted and heel raised unchanged. Lift ONLY the LEFTMOST leading boot 7 pixels above its current ground position, sole facing downward; tiny gap before landing, no weight yet. All other leg placement remains unchanged, do not swap sides or depth.
Lock Image1 face, two buns and long tails, torso, two hands and original left-high/right-low spear grip, red/ivory/gold costume and boots, exact full weapon, head/body proportions, subject scale and framing. No whole-character translation, mirroring, image deformation, running, jumping, high knees, extra limbs or crossed ankles. Keep calm short stride and at least one support foot. Entire hair, spear tip/butt and feet inside margins. Actual transparent alpha, no background/floor/shadow/checkerboard/text. Highest visual finish.
